all: ICBC signs $682.8 million sale-leaseback agreement with Teekay LNG Partners L.P. for four LNG carrier newbuildings
CDB Leasing enters into a sale and leaseback agreement worth $514.28 million with Dynagas for the acquisition of LNG shipping vessels Clean Planet and Clean Ocean
China Eximbank contributes to $787 million syndicated debt financing package for acquisition of four LNG vessels (Pan Asia, Pan Americas, Pan Europe and Pan Africa)
China Eximbank contributes $150 million to $920 million syndicated loan to finance acquisition of 13 shipping vessels (Linked to Record ID#63525)
ICBC contributes $150 million to $920 million syndicated loan to finance acquisition of 13 shipping vessels (Linked to Record ID#63524)
ICBC provides $150 million loan for acquisition of two shipping vessels (Hull No. S452 and Hull No. 2177)
China Development Bank provides $223.8 million loan to Seaspan Corporation subsidiaries to acquire three 10000 TEU newbuilding vessels
China Eximbank contributes $198 million to $330 million syndicated loan to Scorpio Bulkers to finance acquisition of 22 bulk carriers
China Eximbank participates in $385.2 million syndicated loan for acquisition of 6 oil tankers (Linked to Record ID#92514)
China Construction Bank signs $174.3 million sale-leaseback agreement with Teekay LNG Partners L.P. for LNG carrier newbuilding
